Once per combat, when the wounds of a death world character drop below 30%, they gain +20% of their maximum wounds as temporary wounds.
  Death world characters also gain a +20% bonus to dodge and armour while they have at least 1 temporary wound from any a source.
Death world characters gain +15% critical hit chance against targets with the bleeding effect or with 50% or less of their maximum wounds
Death world characters gain +10% to critical hit chance for axes, hammers, and las weapons.
Every Injury increases the death world character's Agility and Willpower by +5. Every trauma counts as 3 Injuries.
Death World characters take TGH bonus less damage from flame, toxic damage, and bleeding effects.

Once per combat, when a death world character is suffering from the stunned, blinded, or immobilised condition, this condition is ignored, and they instead gain +20% temporary wounds to their maximum wounds.

A voidborn character can reroll any failed attack, dodge, parry, characteristic, or skill test with a 20% chance of success. This chance cannot be greater than the base success chance of the roll. 
  Additionally, any enemy dodge or parry against a voidborn character has a 20% chance to fail after a successful roll.
Any time a voidborn character scores a critical hit, there is a 10% chance to double the damage.

Using a non-damaging ability on an ally grants that ally the ability to reroll any failed attack, dodge, parry, characteristic, or skill test with a 20% chance of success for 1 round. This chance cannot be greater than the base success chance of the roll. Using a non-damaging ability on an enemy grants them a 20% chance to fail a successful dodge or parry test against any character for 1 round.
The voidborn character has a 20% chance to survive after suffering lethal damage, surviving with 1 wound.

While a voidborn character has more than 50% wounds, all chances of all creatures (including enemies) in a 3-cell radius are increased by +10%. While a voidborn character has less than 50% wounds, all chances of all creatures (including enemies) in a 3-cell radius are decreased by -10%.

Any time an ability or talent uses the Fellowship bonus, a voidborn character can instead use the Intelligence bonus, if it is higher. Additionally, voidborn characters can always upgrade Intelligence even if their archetype does not allow it.
Hive world characters gain +((1 + FEL bonus) / 2) resolve if there are 3 or more creatures (allies or enemies) in a 3-cell radius. Yet they suffer a -2 penalty to resolve with no creatures around.
Hive world characters can pass Willpower resistance tests using their Fellowship value instead, if the character's Fellowship is higher.

If a hive world character has melee superiority against the enemy, the effect is increased by +10. If an enemy has melee superiority against a hive world character, the effect is decreased by -10. Melee Superiority: in melee combat, any target surrounded by more allies then enemies receives a +10 WS bonus for each additional ally. Larger creatures need to be surrounded by more than two enemies to provide this advantage to the attackers.
All ranged weapons dealing physical damage have +1 damage, +5% armour penetration, +1 rate of fire, and -5 to recoil.

If a hive world character starts their turn adjacent to an ally character, that hive world character gains +2 MP. If a hive world character ends their turn adjacent to allies, they all gain +2 MP on their next turn.
Hive world characters gain a +50% bonus to dodge against the first attack of opportunity every round.
choose one: Subskin Armour, grants 5+(2xTGH) % armour - Locomotion System, grants AGI/2 MP and 2xAGI % dodge - Analytics system, grants 10+INT % critical hit chance
The first attack in combat with any plasma, melta, or power weapon deals additional damage equal to INT bonus. For the remainder of combat, the bonus damage is decreased to (INT bonus / 2).
Forge world characters gain +TGH bonus deflection against the burning effect and flame weapons.
While wearing heavy armour, forge world characters gain +1 MP, +1 deflection, and cannot fall prone.

Forge world characters gain a stacking +10% bonus to hit chance and dodge reduction against any target they hit with a single-target attack. Successful critical hits from single-target attacks increase the hit chance and dodge reduction by +20%.
Forge world characters can use Persuasion, Coercion, and Commerce based on Intelligence instead of Fellowship.
Imperial world characters can select any characteristic (except for Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill) and add a +10 bonus.
When an Imperial world character is affected by an ally's non-damaging ability or affects an ally with such an ability, their resolve is increased by (FEL bonus / 2) for 1 round.

Talent: Better to die for the Emperor
column2: While under 40% wounds, Imperial world characters gain a +10 bonus to all characteristics and +2 to resolve.
If no other character in the current party is from an Imperial world, the first use of any of the character's archetype abilities costs -1 AP less.

Imperial world characters gain +10% critical hit chance and +10% armour against xenos or daemonic creatures. Their allies gain half the bonuses of know no heresy. However, Imperial world characters' Lore (Xenos) and Lore (Warp) are always 0.
All allies, excluding xenos, in the current party gain +5 to the same characteristic as was chosen for Humanity's Finest.

Each time a fortress world character kills an enemy, they gain +10 stacks of never stop shooting. At the start of their turn, there is a (stacks of never stop shooting)% chance that the first attack this round will cost 0 AP and will not 
  count toward the attack limit per round. If this effect triggers, all the stacks are lost.

Fortress world characters gain +7 to Ballistic Skill, Perception, and Willpower while in combat. Yet while out of combat, their Intelligence, Fellowship, Perception, and Willpower are decreased by -7.

Each round fortress world characters gain a stacking +1% bonus to dodge against ranged attacks for each shot they made during this round. Also, the burst attack grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.
At the end of their turn, fortress world characters gain stacks of never stop shooting equal to (half the minimal damage of the most damaging ranged weapon they used this round).
Fortress world characters' first reload in combat costs 0 AP. Reloading a weapon grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.

When all stacks of never stop shooting should be lost, they become (WP / 2) number of stacks instead. Additionally, a fortress world character may upgrade their Willpower characteristic even if their 
  current archetypes do not allow it.
Three paths: Castigator (voice), Subductor (Shield), Vigilant (Shotgun)
The Arbites can wield two handed shotguns in one hand
The Arbirator can parry incoming attacks with a ranged weapon. Ballistic Skill determines parry instead of Weapon Skill. Attacks of opportunity can be used with ranged weapons that work in melee
The Arbitrator's attacks reduce enemies' armour by (10+2xArbitrator's PER bonus) for 1 round. Does not stack
The Arbitrator's attacks made on others' turns deal (10+ WP)% more damage. The targets must pass Willpower test or become immobilised for 1 round.
The Arbirator gains Tougness equal to half their equipped shield block
Once per turn the Arbitrator can throw a grenade that does not deal lethal damage on impact. That action costs 0 ap and does not count towards the attack limit per turn
Whenever an enemy adjacent to the Arbitrator fails a willpower resistance test for the first time in a round, that enemy provokes an attack of opportunity from the Arbitrator
Allies in a 3 cell radius around the Arbitrator deal 5+coercion / 20)% more damage. Does not stack
During the tactical phase, the arbitrator can be placed in a cell adjacent to an enemy
As long as the arbitrator has more than 90% wounds, they are immune to the following negative effects, blinded, disturbed, fatigued, perplexed, slowed and staggered
After the arbitrator uses a heroic act or desperate measure, they gain (10+2xWP) coercion and WP % block until the end of combat
With a one handed shock baton, power maul or one handed power hammer, the Arbitrator gains 10% parry and reduces the weapon skill of enemies by -10 on hit (does not stack). +25% crit damage.

when used for 1 round the commander and their allies do not suffer damage from allied attacks and deal (20+2xfel)% more damage to enemies that were attacked by them since this ability activation. The effect does not stack. Can only be used once per combat

Whilst Regimental tactics effect lasts, the commander and their allies weapon attacks gain +20% dodge reduction, parry reduction, block reduction and cover penetration that have been attacked by allies this combat
While the Astra Militarum commander is under the Regimental Tactics effect, all their allies gain +5% to rate of fire for every attack they have made since the start of this effect.

Two-handed las weapons equiped by the commander or allies gain a bayonet strike single melee attack that costs 1 ap. This attacks deals the same damage as the las weapon and does not count to attack limit.
Whenever the commander or their allies performs a heroic act, all the commander's characteristics are increased by +7 until the end of combat
While the commander is in partial cover, their las weapon's rate of fire is increased by 20% and 40% when in full cover.

Commissar shoots an allied character with the pistol in their primary hand, dealing 100+coercion % of weapon damage. This shot ignores armour and deflection. Always hits. Ally gains at all costs effect, if the ally falls unconscious the effect is instead applied to all other allies besides the commissar. (2xFEL)% damage, (2xFEL)% dodge and parry and (commissar's coercion /10) to all characteristics
Iconic Sidearm: Shots with pistol in their primary hand deal (2x commissar's bs bonus)% more damage, gain 15% critical hit chance, and (2x commissar fel bonus)% dodge reduction

While the Commissar is adjacent to an enemy, all their allies gain +(1+ Commissar's FEL bonus / 2) resolve, if there are no creatures in a 2 cell radius the commissar gains this bonus resolve

The commissar's MP is increased by (1+ character level \10). All allies, starting their turn in a 2-cell radius around the commissar also gain, (1+ character level \10) mp. Once per round, after the commissar performs an attack with a pistol, they gain (Fel \ 2) MP. Does not stack
When the commissar uses At All Costs! while shooting from behind, the bonuses granted by the effect are doubled.

If an ally remains in combat after being attacked with the ability at all costs and then kills an enemy whilst under the effect, they will regain 30% of the wounds lost due to at all costs as temporary wounds

At the start of combat, the crime lord gains +INT bonus stacks of the sure-fire plan effect. Activation of this ability consumes 1 stack and makes the next action stronger depending on the type of action:
  - If the crime lord attacks, they deal +(10 + PER bonus)% more damage. - If the crime lord moves, they gain +(10 + PER bonus)% dodge and parry until the start of their next turn.
  - If the crime lord uses a non-damaging ability on an enemy, that enemy suffers a -(10 + INT bonus)% penalty to damage for one round. Can be used multiple times per turn.
The bonus damage of sure-fire plan is increased by +(2 X WS bonus)%. Killing at least one enemy with an attack restores 1 stack of sure-fire plan.
The bonus to dodge and parry from sure- fire plan are increased by +(2 X AGI bonus %. Dodging or parrying at least one attack by the start of the next round restores 1 stack of sure-fire plan.
An enemy affected by sure-fire plan also suffers a -(10 + 2 X PER bonus)% penalty 10 dodge and parry reduction.
If at the start of a turn, the crime lord has no stacks of sure-fire plan, they gain +1 stack.

Once per combat, if the crime lord has at least 1 stack of sure-fire plan, they do not die from lethal damage. Instead, they heal (5 X sure-fire plan stacks)% of maximum wounds, lose a stacks, and can no longer gain sure-fire plan stacks.

Grants 2x number of steal stacks momentum. Then the priest gains WP bonus stacks of zeal. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Whilst in combat priest gains +willpower. Attacks with bolter, flamer, chain, melta or power per enemy attacked for the first time in combat. They gain +2 stacks of zeal for xenos and daemons killed in combat.
Unshakable Faith: in combat priest gains (2x (str, tgh, agi, per)) willpower
Whenever the character uses war hymn or furious recital, each daemon and xenos in a 5 cell radius suffers 5x zeal stacks direct damage and +1 stack of perplexed

Whenever the priest uses war hymn, for 1 round, the priest themselves and allies in a 5 cell radius deal +number of zeal stacks /2 more weapon damage. This is doubled against daemons, psykers and xenos

The priest deals +WP/3 more damage and wp% more critical damage with bolt weapons. Base melta weapon and flamer damage is increased by WP bonus%. These bonuses are doubled against daemons, psykers and xenos
Priest's maximum wounds are increased by Willpower bonus
Priest gains WP bonus% armour penetration with chain and power weapons. Critical hits scored with such weapons inflict WP bonus /2 levels of burning. Bonuses doubled vs xenos, daemons and psykers

For 1 round, the Navy officer and their allies in a 5-cell radius gain +2 deflection for each Archetypes taken by the Navy officer. They also cannot be forcefully moved or overpenetrated. ! Can only be used once. +1 charge when the navy officer drops below 50% for the first time in combat.
Enemies in a 5 cell radius around the navy officer whilst brace effect lasts suffer -(10x number of archetypes) weapon skill and ballistic skill
All allies affected by Braced effect or by the navy officer non attacking archetype abilities gain (10+2 x PER)% dodge for 1 round. Officer and braced allies do not provoke attacks of opportunity
When the navy officer scores a critical hit or successfully parries an attack with their primary melee weapon, they immediately make an attack with their secondary weapon against the same enemy
Brace for Impact! also allows the Navy Officer to use any ranged weapon in threatened areas, knocks enemies prone, and pushes them 1 cell away during the effect.
All allies affected by Brace for Impact! gain an extra turn with O AP and 3 MP and increase their cover efficiency by +20% for 1 round.

The noble assigns one ally who Will become their servant until the end of combat. Any time the noble's abilities affect the servant, the servant gains +5 to all characteristics until the start of the noble's next turn. Any time the servant attacks a target that the noble dealt damage to last turn, the servant gains +(10 + noble's FEL bonus)% critical hit chance against that target. Can only be used once per combat.
If a noble uses an ability on their servant, the servant gains +1 AP next turn. Does not stack with itself.

If the noble and the servant are adjacent to each other at the start of the noble's turn, they both gain temporary wounds equal to servant's TGH bonus or noble's FEL bonus depending on which is higher.
The noble's servant gains +2 movement points every turn.
If the servant kills the target that the noble dealt damage to last turn, the noble gains +1 AP next turn.

If the servant has less than 30% maximum wounds, the noble can use You. Serve Me. once more in battle, designating a new servant and removing the effect from the previous one. The noble cannot designate a character who already was their servant this combat.
Sanctioned Psykers have reduced 20% chances to trigger psychic phenomena.

The psyker's resolve is increased by +(WP bonus / 2) while veil degradation is 10 or lower.

The psyker gains the Inscribed Soul ability. It costs no AP but deals direct damage to the psyker equal to 25% of the psyker's maximum wounds. The next psychic power used after this ability will not trigger psychic phenomena or perils of the warp and will not degrade the veil.
Psychic powers have a 25% chance to regain AP spent on psychic powers when veil degradation is 10 or lower.
Force weapon attacks deal +psy rating more damage and have +(5 X psy rating)% more armour penetration.
Usage of a heroic act by the psyker decreases veil degradation by INT bonus.
Whenever the psyker uses a damaging psychic power on targets that are 6 cells or farther from the psyker, the targets suffer an additional +BS bonus damage.
The psyker's psychic powers that have a range of 2 cells or more have their range increased by +PER bonus.
The first psychic power used each turn increases veil degradation by 2 points less. If this talent reduces the effect on veil degradation to less than 0, veil degradation is instead decreased by 1.

The psyker can use a damaging psychic power while being threatened by enemies in melee range without provoking attacks of opportunity. Non-damaging psychic powers do not provoke attacks of opportunity even without this talent.
While the psyker is not in the target's line of sight, or the psyker is in cover, all resistance tests of the target suffer a -(4 X psy rating) penalty.
The target gains +(10 + 4 × psyker’s psy rating) Strength and Toughness until the end of combat.
On the first turn of every combat, all psychic powers of the biomancy discipline cost -1 action point.
All the psyker's attacks, including damaging psychic powers, now poison enemies. This poison deals (4 x psy rating) damage every turn.

Every time the psyker deals damage, they gain +1 stack of the sanguine siphon effect. If that damage was dealt to a target adjacent to the psyker, they gain +2 stacks instead. When the psyker suffers lethal damage, the stacks of sanguine siphon are removed to reduce this damage by -1 for each stack, until either all stacks are removed or the damage is no longer lethal.

Whenever the psyker is healed or heals any ally, if the character being healed is already at full wounds, that character instead gains temporary wounds equal to the healing. These temporary wounds do not stack.

When an enemy adjacent to an ally dies, that ally gains a stacking corpus conversion effect. If multiple allies are adjacent to the dead enemy, one is selected at random. The psyker's next psychic power that targets only the target with corpus conversion will work as if the psyker's psy rating is +2 higher, will not damage the veil, will not trigger psychic phenomena or perils of the warp, and will remove -1 stack of corpus conversion from the target.
  (This talent appears to be bugged and adds +2 psy rating on every psyker buff which stacks until an offensive psyker power is used)

Whenever the psyker heals themselves or another character with a psychic power or an effect applied by a psychic power, this healing can critically heal with a chance of (5 + 2 x WP bonus)%. This critical heal chance is increased by all the effects that increase critical hit chance, and the amount healed is increased by the same value as critical damage.
When the psyker's allies or the psyker themselves are under the effects of the psychic powers, they gain +5 Toughness for each of such effects.
Whenever an effect applied by the psyker increases the damage suffered by a target, this effect is increased by half (for example, a 20% increase turns into a 30% increase).
The psyker increases the target's dodge and parry by +(3 + psyker’s PER bonus + 3 × psy rating)% until the end of combat.
At the beginning of every combat, the psyker's allies gain +15% critical hit chance. The first critical hit removes this effect.
Allies under the effect of at least one psychic power gain an additional +(5 + 2 x psyker's psy rating)% armour penetration.
Every 9th successful dodge and/or parry by the psyker and their allies combined grants the psyker +2 additional AP on the next turn.
The first dodge attempt of every enemy in combat suffers a -(7 X psyker's psy rating)% penalty.

When the psyker uses a Divination psychic power on an ally without an unnatural luck effect, that ally gains unnatural luck. 
 Unnatural Luck: when the ally suffers a critical hit, it becomes a normal hit instead and the unnatural luck effect is removed.

The target suffers (1 + WP +6 x Psy rating) to (2x WP bonus + 10 x psy rating)) damage and gains the warp burn effect. This attack has (5 × psyker’s psy rating)% armour penetration. Warp Burn 3 + WP + 3 x PSY rating
The psyker's critical hit chance increases by +1% until the end of combat every time the psyker deals damage by any means.
Whenever a psychic power used by the psyker deals damage, a random enemy within 2 cells from the initial target suffers half of this damage. That damage does not trigger this talent again.
The psyker gains +(8 X psy rating)% additional armour against fire damage and half this amount as additional armour against energy damage from las, melta, and plasma weapons.
When the psyker is burning, the psyker's psy rating is increased by +1, and the psyker's resolve is increased by 2. Damage from fire no longer reduces the psyker's momentum.

When the psyker uses a psychic power, all enemies adjacent to the psyker suffer (4 X psy rating direct damage. The same also 1 happens when the psyker suffers damage from burning, bleeding, or melee attacks.
Every time the psyker kills or scores a critical hit against 8 creatures in one combat, the psyker's next attack (including attacking psychic powers) will cost 0 AP and have no cooldown.

Every time an enemy suffers damage from the psyker, that enemy's armour is reduced by -5%. If the enemy's armour is already 0, this enemy's deflection is reduced by -1 instead. (Seems buggy and doesnt always apply armour strip)

All damage-over-time effects applied by the psyker gain a 5+5xpsy rating % if the character hhas sparks of the greater flame, 20% if the character has does it hurt? 10+greater of the above % if the character has both these talents
  critical hit chance. This chance is increased by all bonuses to critical hit chance
All allies in a circle with a 5-cell radius gain + 1 + psy rating resolve until the end of combat. Every additional stack of this effect increases the resolve bonus by +2.
The psyker's armour increases by +5%. This bonus increases by +5% at the start of every turn of combat except the first.
Enemies adjacent to the psyker suffer +10% more damage.

The first time that momentum reaches 200 during the psyker's turn, the psyker gains +5 to all characteristics, +1 to resolve, +1 to deflection, and +1 to all damage that the psyker deals until the end of combat.
Critical hits scored by anyone within the psyker's line of sight (including the psyker themselves) increase the psyker's critical damage by +1% until the end of combat. Stacks.
The psyker's psy rating is increased by +1 until the end of combat every time an ally uses a heroic act.
The psyker's critical hit chance is increased by +Resolve%.
Deals 4 + (psyker’s WP bonus × (1 + psy rating)) to (4+ psyker's WP Bonus x (1 + psy rating))) damage to the target.
Every time the psyker deals mental damage from any source other than Aftershock, the target suffers half as much mental damage at the end of its next turn.
Enemies that have taken damage from the psyker at least once suffer a -20 penalty to all resistance test against the psyker until the end of combat.

Enemies that have failed a Willpower resistance test against any of the psyker's psychic powers will suffer an additional +(4 X psy rating) mental damage every time they suffer mental damage until the end of combat.

Any time an enemy becomes a target of any particular psyker ability for the first time, this enemy suffers a -5 penalty to their intelligence and perception, and the psyker's intelligence and perception increase by +2 until the end of combat
Whenever the psyker kills an enemy with a psychic power dealing more damage than wounds of the target, the excess damage will be dealt to the enemy closest to the target.
Enemies that become targets of the psyker's psychic powers gain a stacking -5% penalty to their dodge and parry until the end of combat.
After every sixth use of a psychic power by the psyker, all enemies gain a stacking -5 penalty to all characteristics until the 1 end of combat.
Enemies, currently inflicted with blinded, stunned, immobilised, or prone effects by the psyker, suffer +10% more damage.

Whenever an enemy attacks the Warrior, the Warrior's next melee attack against that enemy deals an additional +TGH bonus damage. Does not stack, but it can be reactivated after another attack made by either the same enemy or  a different one.
The Warrior deals an additional +AGI bonus damage to enemies that have no allies in adjacent cells.
The Warrior's critical damage is increased by +(10 + 2 × STRbonus)% against enemies not armed with a melee weapon.
If the Warrior has less than 50% wounds, they gain +(5 + (TGH bonus + AGI bonus))% critical hit chance.

Whenever the Warrior is attacked, they gain +1 stack of epicentre of slaughter until the end of combat. At the start of their turn, the Warrior gains +1 temporary wound for each stack. These temporary wounds cannot exceed the  Warrior's TGH bonus.
The Warrior gains +1 damage deflection. Their parry chance is increased by +25% of the Warrior's total armour.
Each use of Slash increases the damage dealt by Slash by +1 until the end of combat.
Attacks of opportunity deal -(10 + 3 X WS bonus)% less damage to the Warrior. Movement within range of attacks of opportunity costs -1 MP less.
The Warrior gains +TGH bonus damage deflection against the first attack made by every enemy this combat.
Area attacks deal an additional +(1 + STR Bonus / 2) damage for each enemy in the area of effect.
When the Warrior takes damage, they gain +(5 + 2 X AGI Bonus)% dodge. Stacks up to 3 times and resets after a successful dodge.
If the Warrior has not attacked this turn, they gain +(10 + 2 X TGH bonus)% armour. Charge and Slash do not affect this bonus.
When the Warrior uses a single-shot attack or a melee attack against a target, the Warrior gains +(5 + 2 X TGH bonus)% armour against attacks made by that target for 1 round.
Allows the Fighter to use Medikits without Medicae Skill. The Fighter also regains additional Wounds equal to their TGH Bonus whenever the Medikit is used on them.
Whenever the Warrior is hit while under the Endure effect, their damage deflection is increased by +1 until the Warrior's next turn.
The damage dealt by Charge is increased by +(TGH bonus + STR bonus) when the ability is used from a distance of 5 or more cells.
When the Warrior parries an attack, their next Warrior archetype ability costs -1 AP less.
When the Warrior ends their turn near an enemy affected by the Sworn Enemy ability, the Warrior gains +(2 + TGH bonus) temporary wounds.
Enemies suffer a -10% penalty to their hit chance with ranged attacks (including area attacks) against the Warrior for every enemy in a 1-cell radius around the Warrior. Stacks up to 3 times.
If there are no enemies adjacent to the Warrior at the start of the turn, the Warrior's damage is increased by +(2 X STR bonus) for one melee attack.
Charge and push increase the damage of ranged attacks made against affected enemies by +(5 + WS bonus)% until the end of combat. Does not stack.
Increases Charge distance by +3 cells.
Whenever the Warrior hits with Reckless Strike, this attack scores a guaranteed critical hit.
The Warrior becomes incredibly deft. Charge and Slash do not end the Warrior's movement and grant +(10 + AGI bonus)% dodge for 1 round after use.
When the Warrior uses Slash with two melee weapons equipped, the Warrior deals damage from both weapons. (Currently bugged and does not work with rigorous training)
Whenever an ally uses a heroic act, that ally gains temporary wounds equal to (10% of their maximum wounds + Resolve).
The range of the Officer's abilities is increased by +3. The range of Voice of Command is increased by +6.

Whenever the Officer uses an ability on an ally, that ally gains a bonus to their Perception and Ballistic Skill equal to 2+(Officer's Resolve Bonus/2). These bonuses stack, but half of the stacks (rounded up) are lost at the end of the target's turn.
Whenever the Officer targets an ally with an ability for the first time in a round, that ally gains +WP bonus temporary wounds.

Whenever the Officer targets an ally with an action (an ability or an attack), that ally's resolve is increased by +1 until the end of the Officer's next turn. This effect stacks and is prolonged until the end of the Officer's next turn each time it stacks. Cannot be prolonged past the Officer's next turn.
The Officer's resolve is increased by +3
Whenever an ally is affected by an Officer's ability or talent that grants temporary wounds, that ally's armour is increased by +10% for 1 round. Does not stack.

Allies under the effect of the Officer's abilities gain a bonus to their Weapon Skill equal to (3 + Officer's FEL bonus) and will deal +FEL bonus more damage on attacks of opportunity until the start of the Officer's next turn.
Whenever the officer uses voice of command or bring it down! foor the first time in combat, this ability costs -1ap
Whenever a heroic act is used in combat by any character, the Officer's next attack will cost 0 AP.
Air of Authority immediately grants momentum to the target equal to the target's resolve.
Allies affected by the Officer's abilities gain a bonus to all resistance tests equal to (2 X Officer's WP bonus).

Half of the bonus granted by the Voice of Command remain until the end of combat. This bonus does not stack with itself or with bonuses granted by Voice of Command but does count as an Officer ability effect for the purposes of other talent effects.

Whenever the Officer uses an Officer archetype ability two times in one turn that does not grant an extra turn, they gain the stand witness effect. Stand Witness: the next Officer archetype ability that does not grant an extra turn will also affect the Officer.
Whenever the Officer makes an attack, they gain +5 Fellowship until the end of combat.

Whenever the Officer's ability moves any target, the Officer gains movement points equal to half the distance the target moved. If this happens on another character's turn, the Officer will gain these movement points on their next turn.
Whenever the Officer's ability grants action points to an ally, that ally also gains +1 to all characteristics for every action point gained until the end of combat.
Whenever an ally starts a turn (including any extra turn) adjacent to the Officer, that ally gains additional MP equal to (Officer's FEL bonus / 2).
Break Their Ranks! works as if there were one more enemy adjacent to the target. This allows this ability to be used on targets with no enemies adjacent to them.
Allow officers and allies under the effect of the officer's Voice of Command to deal additional damage to enemies that have not yet acted in this combat.
Take Aim! also increases the damage of the next ranged attack by 5% + 1% for each cell between the attacker and the target.

The fficer gains +10 willpower and +10 fellowship when they have less than 50% of their maximum wounds remaining. They also gain an additional +10 willpower and +10 fellowship after using any officer ability on a target withless than 50% wounds for 1 round. These two sets of bounuses stack with each other but do not stack with thesmelves (+20 willpower and fellowship)
Targets of Move! Move! Move! gain a +10% bonus to dodge and a +10% bonus to cover efficiency until the start of the Officer's next turn.

Get Back in the Fight! removes 1 fresh injury from the target and heals the target for (Officer's WP bonus / 2) wounds for each condition removed by Get Back in the Fight! (including fresh injuries). A minimum of (Officer's WP bonus / 2) wounds is always healed, even if no conditions are removed.
Whenever the Operative attacks an enemy that is at full wounds, that attack deals +(10 + PER bonus)% more damage to that enemy.
Expose Weakness costs 0 AP.
Whenever the Operative triggers an exploit on an enemy, the Operative gains +1 damage and +2% armour penetration until the end of combat. Stacks.
Expose Weakness also reduces enemies' Toughness and Willpower by -(3 X INT bonus) for 1 round.
If the Operative attacks a target affected by an exploit from a distance of (15 - PER bonus) cells or farther, that attack deals +15% damage.
While the Operative's Perception bonus is 10 or higher, they gain +1 AP and ignore enemies' deflection.
If the target of Analyse Enemies has 2 or more exploits, that target suffers +1 additional exploit.

At the start of the Operative's turn, the enemy with the largest number of exploits receives an additional exploit stack. If two or more enemies are tied for the largest number of exploit stacks, one of those enemies is chosen at random.
While the Operative is in half cover, their cover efficiency is increased by +15%. This bonus is doubled if the Operative has not moved during their turn.
Tactical Knowledge requires 3 exploits instead of 4. The Operative's damage is increased by +INT bonus.
Whenever the Operative hits an enemy that is affected by both an exploit and Expose Weakness, that enemy loses -3 MP and their damage is reduced by -20% on their next turn.
If the Operative uses Precise Attack on a target affected by (10 - INT bonus) or more exploits and scores a hit, that hit becomes a critical hit.
Precise Attack grants the Operative a bonus to Perception equal to (number of exploits removed / 2) (minimum 1) .
The Operative's allies gain +Operative's INT bonus / 2 hit chance and critical hit chance while attacking targets affected by exploits.
The Operative suffers -(5 + INT bonus)% less damage from enemies affected by exploits.

On their first turn in combat, the Operative randomly distributes the same number of exploits as when using Analyse Enemies among all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the Operative. At the start of each of the Operative's 
subsequent turns, they distribute half as many exploits (half the base amount) among all enemies in a 2-cell radius around the Operative.
If an enemy affected by an exploit within 5 cells from the Operative attacks the Operative or their ally, that enemy suffers +1 additional exploit.
If the Operative has not moved this turn, they gain +PER bonus Ballistic Skill and +(INT bonus / 2) damage for every 5 cells between them and the target.
Perfect Spot additionally grants the Operative +(5 + PER bonus)% armour penetration against enemies that are 7 cells away or farther.
If Intimidation kills the target, the damage of all other enemies in the area of Intimidation is reduced by an additional -(4 X INT bonus)%.
The Operative inflicts an exploit even on enemies which are out of the Operative's line of sight at the start of the turn.
For each adjacent ally, the Soldier deals +(5 + BS bonus)% more damage to enemies.
Cover efficiency is increased by +10% for full cover and +20% for half cover.
Whenever the Soldier deals damage, their critical damage is increased by +1% until the end of combat.
After the Soldier deals damage to 3 different enemies, the Soldier gains +(10 + 2 X BS bonus)% more damage for their next attack in the current combat.
Reloading costs -2 AP less (minimum 1). The first reload in a combat does not cost AP.
The Soldier gains +(3 + AGI bonus)% critical hit chance. This bonus is doubled against enemies from which the Soldier is protected by cover at the moment of the attack.
Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 Agility until the end of their next turn.
Healing an ally with a medikit in combat restores additional wounds equal to (Medicae / 10). Using medikits costs -1 AP less.

The Soldier's Demolition instead of Intelligence is used to determine additional damage dealt with ranged area attacks. Deals 5% more damage for every 10 points in Demolition (instead of 5% for each 10 points of Intelligence).
The Soldier's second attack action in a turn deals +(5 + 2 x AGI bonus)% more damage to enemies that have not suffered damage from the Soldier during this turn.
While the Soldier has an ally adjacent to them, Controlled Shot costs -1 AP less to use.

While the Soldier has full cover against an enemy, the Soldier gains +10% damage against that enemy, and the enemy's attacks deal -20% less damage against the Soldier and their cover if the cover is present at the moment when the shot is fired (even if the cover is destroyed by the shot).
While at full wounds, the Soldier has +10 Ballistic Skill and +2 MP.
The first hit of each burst attacks deals additional damage equal to the weapon's current rate of fire.
The next use of Run and Gun, when used after Entrench, grants an additional +AGI bonus movement points.
All of the Soldier's area attacks gain +(5 + 3 X BS bonus)% armour penetration and ignore (BS bonus / 2) deflection when used against enemies in a 3-cell radius around the Soldier.
The Soldier's medium armour does not reduce dodge.
Revel in Slaughter can be used after 2 kills instead of 3.
Dash does not end the Soldier's movement for the turn. Enemies adjacent to the starting point of Dash will consider the Soldier their lowest priority target during their next turn.
Enemies damaged by the Soldier's area attacks suffer +(1 + BS bonus / 2) damage from the next attack that hits them.
Whenever the Soldier successfully dodges or uses cover against an enemy's attack, they gain a guaranteed critical hit against that enemy.
Rapid Fire no longer reduces damage.
Any Bladedancer attacks made with a sword deal + AGI bonus% additional damage. This bonus damage is doubled if using a two-handed sword.

Enemies attacked by the Bladedancer have their weapon Skill, Ballistaic Skill, and Perception reduced by -(10 + Bladedancer's WS bonus) until the start of the Bladedancer's next turn. These penalties do not stack.

The Bladedancer's Medicae is now determined by Weapon Skill instead of Intelligence (if their Weapon Skill is higher). The Bladedancer deals + (5 + Medicae / 10)% critical damage and can use medikits as if having Medicae skill advancement or the corresponding feature or talent.
The Bladedancer's maximum wounds are increased by +(Bladedancer's dodge/10).

each attack made by the Bladedancer increases the damage of all subsequent attacks they make this turn by +5%. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Area attacks, burst attacks (including the Blade Dance), and any other attacks that deal multiple hits are considered single attacks.

The Bladedancer's parry is increased by +TGH bonus%. An attacker's melee critical hit chance bonus determined by the difference between the attacker's and the Bladedancer's Weapon Skill characteristic is halved.
The Bladedancer's melee area attacks cost -1 AP less (but not less than 1).

Whenever the Bladedancer parries a melee attack while under the effect of Veil of Blades, they deal 50% of ther normal damage to the attack. Additionally, while under the effect of Veil of Blades, the bladedancer's chance to deflect a ranged attack at an enemy is increased by +20%.

The Bladedancer can use both a desperate measure and a heroic act in the same combat (but not in the same round). Whenever the blade dancer uses a desperate measure, they gain +10 Weapon Skill and +3 resolve.
Whenever the Bladedancer is healed for the first time in a round, they are healed for an additional +TGH bonus wounds and gain +10 Toughness until the end of combat. Stacks.
Every ally targeted by Oath of Vengeance gains the same bonuses as the Bladedancer against all affected enemies.
Whenever the Bladedancer uses an ability that costs wounds, they gain +3 MP in the current turn.
Whenever the Bladedancer kills an enemy, the Bladedancer's resolve is increased by +1 until the end of combat.
As long as the Bladedancer has two swords equipped, the Bladedancer's Weapon Skill is increased by +AGI bonus.
The Bladedancer deals an additional +(5 + Bladedancer's WS bonus)% damage against enemies armed with a melee weapon.
Whenever the Bladedancer dodges an attack made by an enemy who attacks them for the first time, the Bladedancer gains +1 charge of Death From Above.
The Bladedancer gains +3 Weapon Skill and +3 Agility for every injury they are currently suffering and +10 Weapon Skill and +10 Agility for every trauma.

Whenever the Bladedancer uses an ability that costs wounds, they gain half of the wounds spent as temporary wounds. The number of temporary wounds gained cannot be decreased by effects that reduce the cost of abilities.

Targets affected by Captive Audience have their armour, dodge, and parry reduced by -(10 + AGI bonus)% until the end of combat. This penalty is doubled for targets failing the ability's Toughness resistance test.
Death From Above deals double damage to enemies that have less than 50% wounds.
Every time an enemy is killed by Blade Dancer's allies, the amount of Movement Points Blade Dancer gets on their next turn increases by 2.
If all the strikes made as part of Blade Dance are directed against the same target, the last strike deals double damage.
Whenever the Bladedancer kills an enemy with an attack of opportunity, the Bladedancer immediately gains +1 charge of Death From Above.
Once the Bladedancer has killed four enemies in total, the next ability which requires spending wounds will cost no wounds and instead restore (5 + 2 x TGH bonus) wounds.
Blood Oath restores an additional +1 AP.
As long as the Bladedancer has less than 50% wounds, they gain +12% dodge and +3 MP. The Bladedancer also gains +8% dodge and +2 MP for every unconscious ally in combat.

Whenever the Bladedancer uses Acrobatic Artistry, their dodge and cover efficiency are increased by +(5 + AGI bonus)% until the end of their next turn. This bonus is doubled against all attacks made by enemies during the Bladedancer's turn (including extra turns).
Whenever the Bladedancer parries an attack, the number of attacks made by the next Blade Dance is increased by +1. This effect stacks up to AGI bonus times.

After the Bladedancer loses any number of wounds, their next attack deals +(5+TGH bonus)% more damage. If that loss causes the Bladedancer to suffer an injury or trauma, the bonus damage increases to +(10+2 x TGH bonus)%.
Whenever the Assassin attacks an enemy that is at full wounds, the Assassin gains +20% dodge and dodge reduction against that enemy until the end of the Assassin's next turn.
Whenever the Assassin attacks an enemy with a single-target attack, this attack reduces the target's armour and dodge by -15% until the end of the Assassin's turn. Does not stack.
If an enemy suffers a critical hit from one of the Assassin's allies, at the start of the Assassin's turn, a new opening is created on whichever side is closest to the Assassin.
Each use of Aim for the Opening on the same target reduces that target‘s dodge and dodge reduction by -10%. Stacks.
The Assassin gains +Lethality% chance to deal +5% of target's max wounds more damage to an opening.
Every turn, the first use of an Assassin ability costs 0 AP.

At the start of the Assassin's turn, all enemies that do not have the Assassin in their line of sight suffer the unsuspecting effect until the end of the Assassin's turn. Unsuspecting: the Assassin gains +7% hit chance and +7% critical hit chance against unsuspecting enemies.
The haemorrhage effect applied by Death Whisper deals an additional +10 damage.
For every 10 damage dealt by an Assassin's attack, that attack also deal +1 direct damage to the same target. Direct Damage: damage that cannot be reduced by the target's parameters or bonuses.
Whenever the Assassin deals direct damage, the target must pass an Agility resistance test with a -(2 X Assassin's AGI bonus) penalty or become slowed until the end of their next turn.
If the Assassin is elusive at the start of their turn, they gain +4 MP and +10 lethality until the end of their turn.
Each successful dodge grants the Assassin +(Lethality / 5)% damage for the next successful attack.
Poised to Strike also reduces the target's dodge by -(2 X AGI bonus)%.
The armour penetration penalty of Feinting Attack is reduced to -20%.

Whenever the Assassin deals direct damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the vulnerable effect. Vulnerable: the character suffers +(number of vulnerable stacks) X PER bonus% more damage from the Assassin's attacks. Direct Damage: damage that cannot be reduced by the target's parameters or bonuses.

Whenever the Assassin has no more than 1 adjacent enemy, any enemy that moves into a cell adjacent to the Assassin must pass an Agility resistance test with a -(2 X STR bonus) penalty or fall prone, if possible, and become  immobilised until the start of that enemy's next turn.
Whenever the Assassin hits an opening, the Assassin's damage is increased by +(AGI bonus / 2)% until the end of combat. Stacks.

The enemy last damaged by the Assassin suffers the witness effect. Witness: if a witness does not have the Assassin in their line of sight at the end of the Assassin's turn, that witness suffers (lethality / 3)% of the maximum base damage of the Assassin's current weapon.
Whenever the Assassin deals 5 or more direct damage to an enemy with a single attack, the Assassin gains +10 lethality until the end of combat. Stacks.
While the Assassin has no allies in a 5-cell radius around them, they gain +10% dodge and +10% dodge reduction.
Danse Macabre deals additional +AGI bonus direct damage.
Whenever the Assassin hits a target with an attack that has 100 lethality or greater for the first time in a round, the Assassin immediately regains the AP spent for that attack.
Whenever the Assassin hits an enemy without hitting the enemy's opening, the Assassin gains +2 X (AGI bonus)% dodge until the start of their next turn.

The Assassin gains +15 lethality against enemies that have any of following effects: slowed, immobilised, or haemorrhage. The bonus is gained for each of these effects but cannot exceed +45 lethality.
While the Vanguard has at least 1 temporary wound, they gain +(5 + TGH Bonus)% parry and armour.

All enemies in a 2-cell radius around the Vanguard suffer a -(5 + FEL bonus)% penalty to dodge against all attacks except the Vanguard's. If any of these enemies consider the Vanguard a priority target, those enemies suffer 
  a -(5 + 2 X FEL bonus)% penalty to dodge instead.
Each Stack of unyielding beacon additionally increases armour and parry by +1%.
Critical hits deal -(15 + 2 x TGH bonus)% less damage to the Vanguard.
Allies affected by any of the Vanguard's abilities gain +(2 X Vanguard's FEL bonus)% armour for 1 round. Does not stack.
The Vanguard gains +(5 + 2 x TGH bonus)% parry against enemies that consider the Vanguard a priority target.

Whenever the Vanguard hits an enemy with an attack of opportunity, that enemy must make a Willpower resistance test. On a failed test, the Vanguard becomes this enemy's priority target until the end of the Vanguard's next turn.
At the start of the Vanguard's turn, before their temporary wounds are lost, the Vanguard gains +number of temporary wounds Strength for 1 round.
For each enemy that considers the Vanguard a priority target, the Vanguard's armour is increased by +5%.
Defensive Stance now has a -10 penalty to Weapon Skill for attacks of opportunity granted by this ability instead of -20. These attacks of opportunity deal an additional +TGH bonus damage.
While Bulwark is active, the Vanguard counts as full cover for their allies and grants the adjacent allies +(stacks of unyielding beacon / 2) damage deflection against ranged attacks.
While the Vanguard has at least one ally in a 2-cell radius, the Vanguard gains +(3 Vanguard's TGH bonus)% parry.
Whenever an ally uses Following!, that ally gains +(5 + 2 X Vanguard's FEL bonus)% more damage against all enemies in a 2-cell radius around the Vanguard for 1 round.
The next attack made by an ally under the effect of Forced Distraction additionally grants +3 MP to that ally.

If the target of Provocation is hit by at least one attack of opportunity caused by Provocation, the target gains +1 stack of fatigued until the end of combat. Fatigued: the target suffers a -10 penalty to, Strength, Toughness, and Agility for each stack of fatigued. MP are reduced by -1 for each stack.
All allies affected by the Vanguard's abilities (but not the Vanguard themselves) are -(5 + Vanguard's FEL bonus)% less likely to suffer a critical hit.
Once per round, whenever an enemy that considers the Vanguard a priority target enters a cell adjacent to the Vanguard, that enemy provokes an attack of opportunity.

Whenever an attack made by an ally hits the Vanguard for the first time in a round, that attack deals no damage to the Vanguard. If this attack is a burst attacks, this applies to each successful hit in the burst.
While at maximum stacks of unyielding beacon, the Vanguard gains +7 resolve.
Wall of Rockcrete now grants +TGH bonus temporary wounds to allies.
Whenever the Vanguard's ally in a 2-cell radius around them is hit, the Vanguard grants that ally +FEL bonus temporary Wounds. Once per round for each ally.
Whenever prey is killed, all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the prey have their Agility reduced by -(5 X prey's difficulty tier) for 2 rounds.
Whenever the Bounty Hunter scores a critical hit, they gain +PER bonus% armour penetration until the end of combat. Stacks.
Whenever an enemy is killed by a critical hit scored by the Bounty Hunter or their ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +(2 X enemy's difficulty tier)% damage or 2 rounds.
Each enemy affected by Piercing Shot has their armour reduced by -BS bonus% until the end of combat. Stacks.
Whenever an ally kills prey, the Bounty Hunter gains half of the bonuses granted by Hunt Down the Prey.

Whenever the Bounty Hunter is attacked in melee range for the first time since the end of their turn, they automatically dodge that attack and move 1 cell in the opposite direction from the enemy. The Bounty Hunter does not provoke attack of opportunity with this movement.

Whenever the Bounty Hunter hits an enemy with an attack, they inflict the catch effect on that enemy. Catch: at the start of the Bounty Hunter's turn, this target suffers a stacking - (2 X (catch's difficulty tier + PER bonus))% penalty to 
their armour and dodge. Once the catch moves or suffers damage, the catch effect and the penalties are removed.
If Claim the Bounty kills an enemy, the Bounty Hunter's next attack this turn will always score a critical hit.
Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills an enemy with a critical hit, all allies in a 7- cell radius around the target gain +target‘s difficulty tier% critical hit chance until the end of combat. Stacks.
Whenever the Bounty Hunter scores a critical hit for the first time in a round, they gain +target's difficulty tier movement points.

Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills an enemy whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter immediately reloads their weapon and attacks the closest enemy in their line of sight. This attack gains +50% overpenetration but deals only (4 x (BS bonus + PER bonus))% of the Bounty Hunter's usual damage.
Cull the Bold additionally removes -target's difficulty tier deflection, -(2 X target's difficuIty tier) Willpower, and -(2 X target's difficulty tier) Toughness from the target.

The Bounty Hunter's first critical hit in a round grants their allies a stacking +(target's difficulty tier + Bounty Hunter's PER bonus / 3)% bonus to armour penetration until the end of combat. Once a character with this bonus reloads, the bonus is removed.
When the Bounty Hunter performs a single-shot attack on an immobilised or stunned target, this attack refunds its cost and does not count for the attack limit. Once per round.
Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills prey whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter additionally gains +2 AP.
Raid grants an ally an additional +(2 X prey's difficulty tier)% damage against prey.
Whenever the Bounty Hunter scores a critical hit, the target's armour is reduced by -(BS bonus + target's difficulty tier)% until the end of combat. Stacks.
The Bounty Hunter's allies gain +(3 + Bounty Hunter's PER bonus) critical hit chance against enemies affected with one or more of the following effects: prey, trailed, or immobilised.
Whenever prey deals damage to the Bounty Hunter's ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +prey's difficulty tier% damage against that prey for 2 rounds. Stacks.
Whenever prey that is not being trailed is killed by an ally, the Bounty Hunter gains an extra turn with half of their MP and AP. The Bounty Hunter cannot attack during this extra turn.
Hot on the Trail now has an unlimited range and reduces the target's armour by -(3 + PER bonus)% for 2 rounds.
At the start of the Bounty Hunter's turn, they gain +2 MP for each ally who is adjacent to prey.

Tacticical Advantage: The Master Tactician gains +1 stack of tactical advantage per every 5 momentum gained by the Master Tactician or their allies. The Master Tactician begins combat with the amount of tactical advantage stacks equal to their FEL bonus.
The Master Tactician begins combat with additional stacks of tactical advantage equal to the number of enemies.
The Master Tactician deals +12% more damage to targets with less than 50% wounds and heals +20% more wounds for targets with less than 50% wounds.
All the Master Tactician's abilities work as if the Master Tactician has FEL bonus more stacks of tactical advantage.
For every enemy hit by the Master Tactician's attack, the Master Tactician gains +1 stack of tactical advantage.
Whenever the Master Tactician or their allies gain momentum, they gain +1 more. Whenever the Master Tactician or their allies lose momentum, they lose -1 less.
Using Linchpin now spends only 1/4 of tactical advantage stacks instead of 1/2.
All enemies hit by the Master Tactician have +10% higher chances of hitting a cover when shooting at the Maste Tactician's allies behind a cover.
All allies have +25% dodge against attacks made by allies, deal -25% less damage to allies, and deal -50% less additional damage with critical hits against allies.
Whenever an ally grants the Master Tactician stacks of tactical advantage, that ally also heals 1 wound for every stack granted.
Grenades and medikits cost -1 less action point to use (minimum 0).
Every critical hit scored by the Master Tactician grants them momentum equal to (resolve / 2). Works up to 3 times per turn.
The first ability the Master Tactician uses after the very first heroic act used in combat will cost 0 action points until the end of combat.

Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a heroic act, the Master Tactician gains +5 Fellowship. Whenever their ally uses a desperate measure, the Master Tactician gains +5 Toughness. These bonuses stack and last until the end of combat.
Whenever the Master Tactician or the Master Tactician's ally uses any consumable item (e.g., grenade, medikit, etc.) or reloads a weapon, the Master Tactician gains +2 stacks of tactical advantage.
Finish the Job gains +75% critical hit chance.
Every enemy killed by the Master Tactician increases the Master Tactician's resolve by +1 until the end of combat.
Assign Objective also makes the target suffer +7% more damage from any source until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn.

Using medikits on an ally under the effects of the Master Tactician's archetype abilities heals that target for additional wounds equal to (Master Tactician's FEL bonus + target's TGH bonus) and removes an extra injury wit out any tests.
Whenever the Master Tactician spends tactical advantage stacks on abilities, the critical damage dealt by the Master Tactician increases by +1% for every stack spent until the end of the turn.
Whenever the Master Tactician heals an ally, that ally gains +1 resolve until the end of combat. This effect stacks up to a maximum of +FEL bonus.
Strongpoint also grants half the amount of temporary wounds to the ally closest to the target.
At the beginning of the Master Tactician's turn, if their momentum is higher than 125, the first burst attack or area attack used by the master tactician this turn costs -1 less AP (minimum 0).
Whenever the Master Tactician reloads a weapon, all allies within a 3-cell radius around the Master Tactician also reload their weapons.
Press the Advantage ignores cover and dodge.
The target of Inspire gains +1 additional damage for every 10 stacks of tactical advantage until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn.

If there are more enemies than allies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area gain +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% to parry and dodge. If there are more allies than enemies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area deal +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% damage.
Using a stratagem on a Frontline area grants allies in the area +(10 + 2 x (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus))% increased dodge against other allies' hattacks.
Using a stratagem on a Rear area also makes the allies in that area the enemies' lowest priority targets for 1 round.
Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants all allies in the area +INT bonus deflection against the next melee hit they suffer.
Allies, including the Grand Strategist, in the same Combat Tactics area with the Grand Strategist gain +(3 + INT bonus / 2) Perception and Agility.
All Combat Tactics bonuses are increased by +((INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% if the area was not moved for 2 rounds.
Every time a Combat Tactics area is affected by a stratagem, all allies in that area gain +1 MP for the following turn. Stacks with itself.
After the use of Combat Locus Stratagem, one of the areas removed by Combat Locus Stratagem can be recreated immediately.
Using a stratagem on a Backline area grants allies in the area +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% increased critical hit chance against enemies they are protected by cover from.
Willpower resistance tests forced by Overwhelming Stratagem are made with a -(5 + 2 X (INT + FEL bonus)) penalty.
Enemies in the same Combat Tactics area with the Grand Strategist suffer a -(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% penalty to dodge and parry.
If there are no enemies in the Backline area, the first attack in the turn made by every ally in that area costs -1 AP less.
Allies under the effects of Trenchline Stratagem will dodge area attacks without movement and are immune to all types of forced movement.
At the start of combat, the Grand Strategist gains one random unknown stratagem and can use it until the end of combat for 0 AP.
Re-rolls forced by Killzone Stratagem are made with a -15 penalty.
Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants all allies in the area the ability to move 1 cell without provoking attacks of opportunity.
The first stratagem used in a turn can be used a second time for 0 AP.
Every time allies under the effect of Stronghold Stratagem should have suffered an injury, they gain +(INT + FEL bonus) temporary wounds instead.
Allies gain the ability to reposition the Combat Tactics area they are currently at the cost of 1 AP.

All allies in the Rear area are healed by medikits for +(5 + Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) more and gain the same amount of temporary wounds. Medikits used by allies in the Rear area toost -1 AP less.
Each ally in the Rear area gains +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% critical hit chance if there are no enemies in a 5-cell radius around the ally.
Every enemy killed in the Frontline area increases all bonuses of Combat Tactics areas by +1 until the end of combat.

Each time the Grand Strategist uses a stratagem, they gain a stack of the strategic perfection effect. At 6 stacks of strategic perfection, the next stratagem applies the benefits of all stratagems known by the Grand Strategist, 
  then all the stacks are removed.
Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area for the second time in a turn refunds 1 AP. This effect can be activated once per turn.
Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants the Grand Strategist the ability to use all Officer abilities on allies in the area regardless of distance.
The Arch-Militant begins combat with 2 stacks of versatility.
When entering combat the Arch-Militant gains +(2 X BS bonus) Weapon Skill, and +(2 X WS bonus) Ballistic Skill until end of combat.
The Arch-Militant gains a +(5 + number of Versatility stacks)% bonus to critical damage. This bonus is kept when the Arch-Militant uses Cautious Approach or Confident Approach.
The Arch-Militant gains a +(5 + stack of versatility)% bonus to armour. This bonus is kept when the Arch-Militant uses Cautious Approach or Confident Approach.

When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their armour reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +10% damage. When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their deflection reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +2 damage.

When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their dodge reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant gains +10% critical hit chance. When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their parry reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +20% critical damage.
Whenever the Arch-Militant or their ally uses a heroic act or a desperate measure, the Arch-Militant gains +1 and +10 damage for all attacks until the end of combat.
Gaining a stack of versatility increases critical hit chance by +5% until the end turn. Stacks.
While the Arch-Militant is under the effects of Reckless Rush, their attacks do not cost MP.
Killing an enemy with a melee attack makes all the Arch-Militant's ranged attacks this turn cost -1 AP (min 1), and vice versa. Does not stack.
Every round, the first single-target ability used by an ally on the Arch-Militant grants +1 action point to that ally.
As long as the Arch-Militant has killed at least one enemy with a melee attack this round, the Arch-Militant gains a +(10 + AGI bonus)% bonus to dodge.
Devastating Attack also reduces the target's armour by -7% and Toughness by -10 until the end of combat. Does not stack.
While under the effect of Confident Approach, the Arch-Militant keeps half of the usual bonuses from versatility.
The Arch-Militant can use two-handed ranged weapons within melee range but with a -10 penalty to Ballistic Skill.
The Arch-Militant deals +20% critical damage against targets that are stunned, prone, or blinded.
Any ranged area and burst attacks of the Arch-Militant reduce the Weapon Skill of all enemies hit by -10 until the end of combat. Does not stack.
The Arch-Militant gains +1 stack of versatility whenever an ally grants the Arch-Militant an extra turn.
Any of the Arch-Militant's area attacks, both melee and ranged, reduce the deflection of all the enemies hit by -2 and their armour by -7% until the end of combat. Does not stack.
Any of the Arch-Militant's burst attacks and melee area attacks reduce dodge of all the enemies hit by -8% until the end of combat. Does not stack.
The cost of Wildfire is reduced by -1 AP for every 3 stacks of versatility instead of 4.
The Arch-Militant deals +15% damage to targets that have a priority target regardless of whether that target is the Arch-Militant or someone else.
The Arch-Militant's heavy weapon attacks cost -1 action point.
Enemies that were forced to make a resistance test by the Arch-Militant will make any resistance tests from any source with a -(10 + 2 X AGI bonus) penalty until the end of combat.
Targets of Kick must pass a Toughness resistance test with a -(2 X Arch- Militant's STR bonus) penalty or fall prone for 1 round.

Using Cautious Approach also grants the Arch-Militant temporary wounds equal to 10% of the Arch-Militant's maximum wounds. The same happens at the start of every turn while the Arch-Militant remains under the effect of Cautious Approach.
Whenever an enemy suffers damage from a damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner for the first time in combat, this damage is increased by +100%.

If an enemy suffering from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects is suffering from bleeding, burning (including the effects inflicted by a pyromancer or a Navigator), and toxin (including the effects inflicted by a biomancer) at the same time, all of these damage-over-time effects deal +30% more damage to that enemy.
The maximum number of wounds for the Executioner depends on their Medicae instead of Toughness.
At the start of each round, all enemies suffering from any damage-over-time effects inflicted by the Executioner have their incoming damage-over-time from any source increased by +20%. Stacks.
Targets of Exsanguination are also immune to toxin and burning while suffering from bleeding.
While moving, all bleeding enemies leave a bloody trail on the ground which remains for 1 round. Moving through these bloodstained cells costs the Executioner 0 MP.
Whenever an enemy suffering from toxin inflicted by the Executioner dies, all enemies in a 2-cell radius around that enemy suffer (INT bonus) levels of toxin.
The level of the damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner's Merciless Verdict is increased by +(maximum weapon damage / 5).
When using Scourging Strikes, the Executioner's melee critical hits inflict (3 x STR bonus) levels of bleeding on their targets instead of (2 x STR bonus) levels.
